legal_ref: Goods and Services Tax Act 1993 s.16(cb), as amended by Act 35 of 2022
quote: "Tax is charged at the rate of — ... (ca) 8% for the period from 1 January 2023 to 31 December 2023 (both dates inclusive); and (cb) 9% from and including 1 January 2024" (GST Act 1993 s.16); IRAS: "The current GST rate in Singapore is 9%."
source_title: Goods and Services Tax Act 1993, s.16 Rate of tax (Singapore Statutes Online); IRAS 'Current GST rates' page (iras.gov.sg)
notes: Single standard rate; zero rate (0%) for exports and international services (s.21); exempt supplies under s.22 (e.g. financial services, residential property, investment precious metals). IRAS rate history: 3% from 1 Apr 1994, 4% 2003, 5% 2004-30 Jun 2007, 7% 1 Jul 2007-2022, 8% 2023, 9% from 2024.
unverified: Registration threshold (commonly SGD 1 million taxable turnover) not quoted from an official text
